name: vscode-extension-scripts
description: Scripts for managing VS Code extension collections

scripts.package-all: cd .. && for /d %d in (*-essentials) do cd %d && vsce package --allow-missing-repository && cd ..
scripts.publish-all: cd .. && for /d %d in (*-essentials) do cd %d && vsce publish --allow-missing-repository && cd ..
scripts.test-all: cd .. && for /d %d in (*-essentials) do cd %d && code --install-extension *.vsix && cd ..

author: ih8sirdavi
